<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="finalized" xml:id="ex10012024-07-31-15-292"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4294">khyung po</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4303">mda'</rs> na re sa bcu pa'i dkyil stod la yod pa yin te | de byang ghub seMs dpa'i mngon rtogs yin pas so || des na sa bcu pa'i stod la rnaM kun | dkyil la rtse mo || smad la mthar gyis pa | tha ma la skad cig ma zer ro ||
            de dag gis 'di snyaM du spyir rtse mo brtan par byed pa mthar gyis pa yin no zhes bshad pas | de sa bcu rgyun gyi tha ma la byas na mthar gyis pa'i
         <lb n="40b6"/> bstan byar mi 'thad de | de la rim pa med pa dang | de'i gong na laM gzhan med pa'i phyir ro zhes bsaMs pa yin no || de rnaMs ni mi rigs ste | </seg></TEI>
